cohort: The study included 420 Egyptian women who had undergone at least one previous cesarean section.
finding: Cesarean scar niches were identified in 23.8% of participants, with multiple cesarean deliveries, uterine positioning, postpartum fever, breastfeeding, low post-cesarean platelet counts, and maternal anemia identified as contributing risk factors.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean scar niches increased with the number of previous cesarean deliveries.
